claim: A captured metric is a claim about the real production-mode C3 HTTP path over an attested synthetic corpus. Measured path/authz evidence, hard L0 canary conformance, B0/O0 pinned-implementation drift, raw authoritative quality, and run integrity are separate verdict planes; none may substitute for another.
implementationStatus: DESIGN_AUTHORITY_AND_AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_REDS_ONLY: Ember H1-H4 must execute the measured application path. This v3 artifact is not an H4 certificate; no H1 seed, authenticated HTTP capture, latency distribution, relevance result, or H4 verdict is recorded.

measuredApplicationPath.guarantee: Every measured request must traverse production-mode HTTP authentication, globalSearch, reads.forActor(actor), a c3_app tenant transaction, and PostgreSQL RLS using the attested actor, tenant, role, capability, entitlement, delegation, participant, owner, and claim facts.
measuredApplicationPath.proofSource: Measured H1-H4 receipts only. Authority-reference validators and drift self-tests cannot satisfy this plane.
measuredApplicationPath.nonClaim: Attesting route traversal and the named authz controls is not a proof that every C3 authorization rule is complete or correct.

hardL0Canaries.guarantee: Any active permitted-owner recordKind=Attachment source returned by search is an unconditional L0 conformance failure. Every authored Attachment canary must be materialized and counted independently of B0/O0.
hardL0Canaries.classification: Fail-closed defense-in-depth, not evidence of a known live differential.
hardL0Canaries.nonSubstitution: An Attachment response may also be outside B0, but BASELINE_SOURCE_DRIFT may not replace, soften, or hide the hard L0 failure.

pinnedImplementationDrift.B0: For actor profile a, B0(a) is the source, field, and projection set reconstructed from the C3 search implementation pinned at dae27a400868c0c686788ab8e5520690dbf77334.
pinnedImplementationDrift.O0: O0(a) is the remainder of the explicitly bounded 17-kind synthetic measurement universe.
pinnedImplementationDrift.outsideB0: A resolved response outside B0, or a response whose five-field projection differs from B0, is a pinned-baseline drift finding.
pinnedImplementationDrift.insideB0: Equality to B0 proves equality to the pinned implementation baseline only.
pinnedImplementationDrift.permanentLimit: B0/O0 is not a disclosure oracle and cannot establish that dae27a4 is authorized, correct, complete, leak-free, or backed by a separate authority source.

rawAuthoritativeQuality.guarantee: Recall and MRR use only the human-adjudicated authoritative G judgments. The B0 intersection and its C0 diagnostic never replace or shrink G.
rawAuthoritativeQuality.nonSubstitution: A known pinned-baseline ceiling may explain a quality failure but cannot turn it into PASS.

bundleCoherenceRule.historicalAuthority: HEARTH-003-BUNDLE-MIXING-RED-v1.json plus the recorded r5 closed bundle contract remain historical inputs.
bundleCoherenceRule.r6Requirement: Before H1, the next externally pinned closed authority root must include this v3 trust chain, the B0/O0 drift baseline and RED receipt, and the residual-continuity ledger, contract, verifier, RED plan, and receipt. Until that root exists and verifies, status remains NOT_YET_MEASURED.
bundleCoherenceRule.h1Requirement: Verify the externally pinned root and exact logical-slot map, return frozen verified bytes to consumers, execute every bundle-mixing and continuity RED before any seed, database, HTTP, or metric side effect, and reject any missing, duplicate, historical, renamed, or content-mismatched slot.
bundleCoherenceRule.noVersionMixing: No historical artifact may occupy an operative logical slot even when renamed. Byte-identical shared inputs are explicitly classified as shared, not falsely distinguishable by history.

hashModes.authoredTextAndGitBlobs: strict UTF-8 canonical text; CRLF and lone CR normalize to LF; the artifact terminal-newline convention remains significant
hashModes.semanticObjects: recursively key-sorted UTF-8 JSON.stringify with the declared array ordering and no trailing LF, unless a field explicitly names another versioned algorithm
hashModes.legacyPhysicalSemanticObjects: canonical-json-keysort-plus-one-lf-v1: recursively key-sort object keys, preserve authored array order, UTF-8 JSON.stringify, append exactly one literal LF byte 0x0A, then SHA-256
hashModes.postgresFunctionDefinitions: pg_get_functiondef text normalized CRLF and lone CR to LF before SHA-256
hashModes.rawHttpCaptures: exact captured bytes; no text, line-ending, Unicode, or JSON normalization
hashModes.receiptRule: Every receipt declares its hash mode and recomputes every upstream digest before use. A consumer may not infer a hash mode from a filename or reuse the legacy physical mode outside its two named v3 fields.

legacyPhysicalCanonicalJsonBinding.algorithm: Recursively sort object keys, preserve authored array order, apply UTF-8 JSON.stringify, append exactly one literal LF byte 0x0A, and SHA-256 the resulting bytes.
legacyPhysicalCanonicalJsonBinding.reinterpretationRule: The two recorded v3 digests are not repinned or silently reinterpreted under the no-trailing-LF semantic-object algorithm.
legacyPhysicalCanonicalJsonBinding.futureRule: Any future physical manifest or validation that changes this algorithm must bump its artifact version and declare the new algorithm; pretty-file terminal newlines remain separate from semantic hashing.

policyDependencyBinding.crossBindingRule: The closed authority receipt, this trust chain, and the measured application-read-path receipt must agree on dependencyVersion, sourceCommit, and all three h0Bindings. H4 must independently recompute the dependency tree from the pinned Git blobs; a missing or mismatched value is NON_RECORDABLE.

residualContinuityBinding.canonicalization: recursively key-sorted JSON; group items sorted by stable id; arrays inside an item retain authored order; UTF-8 JSON.stringify; no trailing LF
residualContinuityBinding.h4Rule: The same production continuity verifier must recheck exact schema, unique IDs, exact membership, and content hashes before H1 side effects. The closed-run manifest must hash that pre-run receipt. A missing, hollowed, duplicated, renamed, or content-mismatched residual is NON_RECORDABLE and may not be replaced by a count-only assertion.

oneNumber.name: overallRecallAt10
oneNumber.responseSet: the first ten returned items in serialized wire order after strict source resolution; a duplicate canonical source invalidates the observation before scoring, and no deduplication, reordering, retry substitution, or truncation other than top ten is permitted
oneNumber.emptyAuthoritativeSet: excluded from Recall@10 and reported in the zero-result/denial matrix; never coerced to 1
oneNumber.aggregation: macro within each logical actor-class assignment, then macro within each logical query case, then unweighted macro across eligible logical cases
oneNumber.antiWeightingRule: The 370 concrete Delegation probes may not give the 15 delegated cases more case weight than any other logical case.
oneNumber.baselineJudgmentRole: baselineActorClasses and B0 are pinned-implementation predictions used only for drift and baseline diagnostics; neither may replace authoritativeRelevant or be called an approval oracle.
oneNumber.authzAndCanaryRole: Real-path authz controls and hard L0 canaries are evaluated in their own fail-closed plane before B0/O0 drift diagnostics and metrics.
oneNumber.C0: C0(q,a) = |G(q,a) intersect B0(a)| / |G(q,a)|. C0 is the maximum quality predicted for exact reproduction of dae27a4, not an approved-disclosure ceiling.
oneNumber.targetCeiling: The frozen pinned-baseline prediction gives exact-id Recall@1 <= 109/120, overall Recall@10 <= 1421/1530, and MRR@10 <= 1423/1530. H1 must recompute G intersect B0; any difference is fail-closed.
oneNumber.nonNormalization: G remains the only Recall/MRR denominator. The exact-id target remains 1.00 and an exact B0 reproduction is predicted to report TARGET_FAIL_PINNED_BASELINE_CEILING.
oneNumber.baselineDiagnostic: pinned-baseline exact-ID hit@1 may report 1.00, but it is not Recall@1, does not prove approval, and may not erase G minus B0.

links.mustBeTrue: One externally rooted closed authority bundle is verified before any seed, database, HTTP request, or metric side effect; version mixing, filename laundering, policy-dependency mismatch, and hollowed residual content fail with typed reasons.
links.proof: Executable closed-slot verifier plus clean bundle receipt, complete version-mixing RED receipt, content-bound residual-continuity receipt, and the six-case continuity RED receipt. The verifier checks the external root first, then identities, slots, canonical hashes, cross-bindings, the 5 + 8 + 3 memberships/content, the policy source commit, and all three dependency-tree hashes.

links.mustBeTrue: Every logical class expands to exact physical observations; authoritative G, pinned B0/O0, and diagnostic C0 remain separate; every unconditional quality target is checked against the maximum predicted B0 ceiling before capture.
links.proof: The pre-run adapter hashes G, B0/O0, C0, the hard-canary set, and target classifications. It compares the frozen baseline judgments with G intersect B0 and executes the UNSATISFIABLE_ACCEPTANCE_TARGET RED before any response.
links.executesIn: pre-run oracle and pinned-baseline adapter, before any search response exists

links.mustBeTrue: Each profile execution uses one fresh measured database containing every exact authority row, at least 100000 searchable records across T01/T02, deterministic bulk rows that avoid reserved tokens, every declared hard canary, and exactly its declared sparse D/E/P delta. One complete H4 acceptance run is the closed ordered ten-profile suite H3M.D0, H3M.D1, H3M.D2, H3M.D3, H3M.D4, H3M.E1, H3M.E2, H3M.E3, H3M.E4, H3M.P1, sharing the same baseline/bulk digest and all pins and never merging profiles.
links.proof: Post-seed readback recomputes catalog-primary-key/source/canary counts, the exact profile delta or absence, and a framed row digest. B0/O0 classification covers the bounded corpus exactly once, hard canaries reconcile independently, and no row is silently dropped. D0/E0/P0 are material absence readbacks, not zero-statement overlay assumptions.
links.executesIn: H1 measured database, not the disposable authority validator

links.mustBeTrue: Every request token resolves to the exact tenant, app_user, membership, role, identity, and D/E/P/claim/owner facts declared for its profile; the measured API civil clock is the attested advancing 2035-06-15 clock; cross-tenant collision and named denied-versus-absent controls remain indistinguishable on the wire.
links.proof: Authenticated /me plus profile fact receipt, same-process clock IPC attestation, exact Delegation row-set attestation, D1-versus-D0/D2/D3/D4 /me and /approvals discrimination, tenant collision controls, and per-tenant x seven-role Comms /documents preflights proving E0 deny, E1-E4 current row-existence allow, and anchored-Mission P0/P1 equivalence.
links.executesIn: the exact measured API process and measured database

links.mustBeTrue: Every measured query traverses HTTP authentication, globalSearch, reads.forActor(actor), the c3_app tenant transaction, and RLS; no admin credential is present in the measured process; the running source and dependency trees equal the policy-dependency binding in this artifact.
links.proof: Per-checkout pool attestation, route/request correlation, SET ROLE and tenant-context evidence, fixed source/commit dependency attestation, independent recomputation of the 18-file application, 95-file migration, and 113-file complete tree hashes, and a fail-closed request-path receipt tied to every capture.

links.mustBeTrue: Status, complete serialized body, headers, wire order, and monotonic start/end times are captured before any transformation; no response is silently retried, dropped, pooled, or substituted. Any unexpected timeout, cancellation, 5xx, malformed response, or 429 invalidates the run; warm-up responses also traverse the authz, hard-canary, and drift gates, and 429 responses never enter latency.
links.proof: Append-only framed capture with exact-byte hash, request/profile/query ids, and a strict response-envelope parser.

links.mustBeTrue: Each wire item resolves exactly once. Real-path authz negatives and hard L0 canaries are evaluated first and independently. The same resolved bytes are then compared with B0/O0: outside-B0 identity is BASELINE_SOURCE_DRIFT and changed five-field projection is BASELINE_PROJECTION_DRIFT. A B0 match is never called authorization or leak-free proof.
links.proof: Measured authz-control receipt, zero-return Attachment hard-canary receipt, strict five-key response-schema receipt, sentinel/EXPLAIN/manifest scan, pinned-baseline conformance receipt, and a two-case measured drift RED reproducing one outside-B0 source rejection and one projection-change rejection before metrics. Missing resolution, wrong code, unexpected PASS, hard-canary return, or metricsStarted=true is NON_RECORDABLE.

links.mustBeTrue: Raw authoritative Recall/MRR, pinned-baseline C0, baseline diagnostics, and latency/timing evidence are computed separately from captured wire order and only after the measured authz, hard-canary, and drift gates complete.
links.proof: Per-observation G/B0/result facts, deterministic macros, pinned-baseline ceiling receipt, evaluator hash, ordering/plan evidence, and metric REDs. A predicted B0 ceiling may explain a quality failure but never turn it into PASS or an authorization claim.
links.executesIn: H3 metric evaluator after all fail-first gates pass

links.mustBeTrue: The measurement remains inseparable from the exact authority root, residual-continuity receipt, policy-dependency binding, all RED receipts, G/B0/O0/C0 expansion, target-satisfiability receipt, ten profiles, captures, evaluator, runtime, and independent repeat.
links.proof: Closed run manifests hash every upstream receipt, including bundle mixing, residual continuity, measured authz controls, hard L0 canaries, pinned-baseline drift mutation, policy dependencies, and target satisfiability; a pair receipt then reconciles invariant pins and allowed per-run differences.

links.mustBeTrue: Run integrity, measured path/authz-control conformance, hard L0 canary conformance, pinned-baseline drift, and raw authoritative quality are derived as separate verdict planes. A complete failing baseline remains measurable but cannot emit RECORD.
links.proof: First derive VALID_MEASUREMENT or NON_RECORDABLE from chain evidence. Separately emit measured-path, hard-L0, and B0/O0 drift verdicts. Then compute raw G quality PASS/FAIL/PINNED_BASELINE_CEILING and C0 diagnostics. No metric is lowered or renamed, and B0 equality is never upgraded to authorization or disclosure proof.

physicalValidationV3Boundary.scope: This is an r4-era frozen report bound to QRELS-v5 and Fixture-v5. It is carried as historical physical evidence and is not re-executable evidence in the current bundle.
provesWithinRecordedScope: authority-row storability against its pinned 95 migrations
restricted-role tenant-boundary mechanics exercised by that validator
source-derived projection and complete domainBlock guard-program conformance for its bound inputs
exact D-state rows and explicit-date predicate truth for its bound cases
doesNotProve: that B0/O0 is authorized, correct, complete, leak-free, or backed by a separate authority source
that the current measured H1 corpus contains the required rows and canaries
that a measured token resolves to the intended actor
that the measured live application path traverses reads.forActor and RLS
that the live wall-clock application gate observes D1 as active
that any HTTP response, latency distribution, relevance metric, or H4 verdict exists
physicalValidationV3Boundary.h4Rule: A measured H4 run cannot record from Physical Validation v3 alone. H1-H4 must produce fresh measured-corpus, actor/clock, real-application-path, authz-control, hard-L0-canary, raw-capture, drift, metric, manifest, repeat, and verdict receipts. Until then both this finding and the global package status remain OPEN_BEFORE_H4 and NOT_YET_MEASURED.

recordedResidualAccounting.separationRule: The 5 + 8 + 3 groups remain distinct and content-bound. The r6 pinned-baseline limitation, three structural findings, and six non-blocking record defects are separately bound in the same ledger and may not replace, summarize, close, or renumber any inherited item.
recordedResidualAccounting.unsignedFreezeRoot: SHA-256 plus local Git history and independent recomputation provide tamper evidence against accidental drift. Commits are unsigned and the root is not tamper-resistant against intentional history rewrite. Real PKI or an external append-only anchor remains an owner decision.

currentH0CompatibilityRuling.reason: The H0 schemas require a different qrel shape and deferred detached signatures, omit physical seed-plan, residual-continuity, B0/O0, policy-dependency, and gate-state bindings, and have no H1-H4 producers. Ember must implement a hash-bound authority adapter without changing judgments.
currentH0CompatibilityRuling.pkiRule: Real PKI remains a deferred owner decision. v3 uses SHA-256, unsigned local Git history, and Neural independent recomputation as tamper evidence only; it does not claim intentional-history-rewrite resistance.

runIntegrity.rule: Chain, residual continuity, policy dependency, actor/path, authz controls, hard canaries, capture, timing, receipts, repeat, and manifest closure only. Quality-target failure does not retroactively make a complete measurement nonexistent.

measuredApplicationPath.rule: Attests only the named HTTP authentication to globalSearch to reads.forActor to c3_app transaction to RLS path and named actor facts. NOT_ATTESTED makes the run NON_RECORDABLE.

hardL0Canaries.rule: Any returned active permitted-owner Attachment is HARD_L0_CANARY_FAIL and makes the run NON_RECORDABLE, independently of B0/O0.

pinnedImplementationDrift.rule: This plane reports movement from dae27a4 only. PINNED_BASELINE_MATCH is never an authorization, correctness, completeness, approval, or leak-free verdict.

rawAuthoritativeQuality.rule: Compute unchanged Recall/MRR against G and preserve every HEARTH-001 absolute target. Exact reproduction of the present B0 is predicted to fail exact-id Recall@1=1.00; only a measured run may emit a quality value.

pinnedBaselineDiagnostic.substitutionForbidden: This diagnostic may not be named Recall@1, placed in the G metric plane, described as approved disclosure, or used to erase G minus B0.

recordTokenRule: RECORD remains unavailable until every required measured receipt exists, both independent repeats reconcile, no hard L0 or integrity failure occurs, and every absolute quality target passes. A valid failing baseline may be captured and compared but must not be called RECORD; a B0 match alone never earns RECORD.
